evidence_quote: We happily receive expressions of interest for the following career opportunities: Construction Supervisors and Forepersons Leading Hands Plant Operators Pipelayers & Skilled Civil Workers Engineering Surveyors Site & Project Engineers Undergraduate & Graduate Engineers If this is you, please send your resume to projects@western-civil.com.au , with the subject ‘Career Opportunity’.
employer_line: Western Civil's head office sits in Melbourne's Western Growth Corridor (38 Barclay Road, Derrimut), and its land development team self-performs earthworks, bound and unbound pavements, stormwater drainage, culvert bridges and ancillary concrete works on greenfield industrial and residential subdivisions (https://western-civil.com.au/services/).
notes: Civil contractor founded 2016, ISO accredited, VicRoads prequalified; projects include Merrifield Business Park, Alliance Business Park Stage 6, Jacksons Hill Stage 44, Kingslea Broadmeadows, Clarkes Road Brookfield, Davidson St Broadford (https://western-civil.com.au/projects/). Same EOI text and inbox also on https://western-civil.com.au/contact/. Subject line must be 'Career Opportunity' (can add e.g. 'Career Opportunity - Graduate / Site Engineer EOI, Marc Darenz Masarate'). No named people/emails published on site; none sought from brokers. Derrimut is ~25 min from Melton. tracker.py check: new, not blocked. Gmail (in:anywhere 'Western Civil' OR western-civil.com.au): only Feb 2024 SEEK recommendation alerts, no applications or sent mail.
